item.description:
Phil Collins Interview on Piers Morgan Uncensored Highlights Health, Reconciliation, and Politics

Phil Collins sat down for an hour‑long conversation on Piers Morgan Uncensored where he talked about recent health issues, made amends with Paul McCartney, and shared his views on Donald Trump.

📅 Overview

  • Interview published by Alex Young on Oct 02, 2026.
  • Title of the piece: Phil Collins on Piers Morgan Uncensored: The 7 Biggest Revelations.

🎟️ Ticketing & Attendance

  • Main Office: (360) 417‑7012.
  • Box Office: (360) 452‑3229.
  • Will‑call window located at main entrance; opens one hour before event start time.
  • Must present a valid photo ID for ticket pickup.

  • No late seating during performances.

🚗 Parking & Access

  • Free on‑site parking available; designated handicap spaces near main entrance.

🛡️ Health, Safety & Conduct

  • Venue maintains standard health and safety protocols; masks may be required depending on current guidelines.
  • Valid ID required for alcohol service.

  • Photography/recording policies vary by event and are prohibited without permission.
  • Professional attire recommended; dress code may apply for certain events.

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Children & Family

  • Children welcome during daytime and family‑oriented functions.
  • Children 5 and older permitted; tickets required for children over 3.

  • Evening events typically for age 21+ or as specified by the event.

📞 Contact

  • For venue‑specific questions: (360) 417‑7012 (Main Office) or (360) 452‑3229 (Box Office).
